report:
Plan — self-contained acceptance-contract repair only

Behavior
- Treat package acceptance as one exact ordered lifecycle: issuance → matching start → exactly one matching successful terminal. Reject (do not accept) duplicate/replayed identical terminals, conflicting terminals, terminal/start before issuance, terminal before start, duplicate issuance/start, mismatched tool/id/args, error terminals, orphan lifecycle events, unsupported envelope shapes, and multiple otherwise valid candidates (ambiguity).
- Require terminal acceptance text to equal the package-owned accepted text exactly; prefixes, suffixes, and substring embeddings are not acceptance.
- Apply the same lifecycle law to all five terminating tools (Coder, Fixer, Reviewer, Judge, Collector) in both supported persisted-session and machine/JSON envelopes.
- Validate Collector terminal details against the exact closed recursive production receipt: reject unknown top-level and nested keys and malformed descendants at every report, leg, request-attempt, snapshot, evidence-record, and defined nested diagnostic/raw structure. Keep Collector generated legs-only arguments distinct from the full accepted terminal receipt.
- Emit audit observation only from a uniquely and lawfully bound Judge/Reviewer acceptance; rejected, orphaned, ambiguous, malformed, or merely tool-named records establish none. Preserve all role output contracts and Recorder startup isolation.

Owner
- `src/recorder/extract.ts` owns envelope decoding, ordered lifecycle binding, exact terminal-text comparison, ambiguity rejection, and the bound source of audit observation.
- `src/package-contracts/terminating-tools.ts` remains the shared registry/dispatch leaf for the five tool names, accepted texts, and accepted-detail validators.
- `src/package-contracts/collector-output.ts` owns the generated-output/accepted-receipt distinction and the closed recursive Collector accepted-detail validator. It must remain package-owned and independent of role registration/startup.

Red
- Extend focused shared-contract tests in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` with table-driven matrices for every terminating tool × both envelopes. Demonstrate current false acceptance of replayed identical terminals and substring text, plus ordering, conflict/error/orphan/unsupported-envelope, and multi-candidate ambiguity cases; assert no Receipt and no audit observation (and an extraction failure where ambiguity is the established fail-closed API behavior).
- Add Collector leaf-validator counterexamples for extra keys at the root and each recursive child shape, malformed descendants (including arrays/objects currently passed through), and generated legs-only details. Assert a complete production-shaped Collector terminal remains accepted while generated args remain issuance-only.
- Add explicit Judge/Reviewer negative cases proving an unbound or rejected lifecycle cannot create audit observation, alongside genuine bound controls.

Green
- Replace bucket-based order-insensitive/duplicate-tolerant acceptance with one coherent ordered-state validation over the already decoded shared event stream; require one exact success terminal and reject any lifecycle contamination listed above.
- Change acceptance-text matching from `includes` to exact equality against `acceptedTextFor`.
- Tighten the Collector package leaf into closed recursive validators that enumerate production fields and reject extras rather than copying/preserving them; validate every descendant while retaining the separate `CollectorGeneratedOutput` contract.
- Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`; the matrix must pass for all five tools in both envelopes, exact text, Collector closure, and audit provenance, while existing role-output, package-lifecycle, Recorder admission/startup-isolation tests stay green.

Shared leaf-contract reuse
- Reuse only `TERMINATING_TOOL_NAMES`, `acceptedTextFor`, `validateAcceptedDetails`, `deepEqual`, and `carriesPackageAuditObservation` from the package-contract leaves. Extend the existing Collector leaf validator rather than adding a Recorder parser, session archive reader, role loader, or fabricated Coder Receipt.

Scope / commit
- Authorized files: `src/recorder/extract.ts`, `src/package-contracts/collector-output.ts`, only minimal supporting changes in `src/package-contracts/terminating-tools.ts` if required, and focused tests in `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts`. No Soul, role runtime/output, Recorder startup/admission, session archive, CLI, or unrelated Collector behavior changes.
- Apply as one forward commit from current HEAD, proposed title: `fix(recorder): enforce exact acceptance contracts`. The commit contains the shared leaf tightening and its complete red/green regression matrix as one inseparable acceptance-boundary repair.
